shared_implementation_reasons.source: One original file/configuration identity avoids contradictory facts and repeated parsing
shared_implementation_reasons.conditional_views: All consumers use the same compiler-selected active regions and per-unit coordinates
shared_implementation_reasons.plan_acceptance: Only current exact frozen bindings reuse actual success; no new native execution claim
shared_implementation_reasons.writeback: One selected upstream chain plus strict local readback preserves sole control writer
shared_implementation_reasons.target_environment: One direct argv diagnostic entry; actual SDK build remains separate
shared_implementation_reasons.release_boundary: Packaging and installation select the same runtime inputs; development data remains external
